newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO says Israel trying to destroy peace deals.
newsitem.headline: PLO says Israel trying to destroy peace deals.

text.p: A senior PLO official on Sunday accused Israel of systematically aiming to scrap peace deals and gradually implement a new plan depriving Palestinians of self-determination on their land.

"The plan of the current Israeli government is to reach an unjust settlement with the Palestinians. It is to give Palestinians limited administrative powers but no control over the land," Palestinian Information and Culture Minister Yasser Abed-Rabbo told reporters.

"Israel has started to implement this plan by gradually destroying the PLO-Israeli peace deals through land confiscations, building settlements and by demolishing Palestinian houses in areas not under its civilian jurisdiction," he told reporters.

Top PLO negotiator Mahmoud Abbas, better known as Abu Mazen, said Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's government, which came to power last June, was returning to a formula of Likud Prime Minister Menachem Begin as part of the Camp David accords in 1978 with Egypt and rejected by Palestinians.
"That proposal gave Palestinians limited powers to administer themselves but no control over the land," Abbas told Reuters.
"An occupier has no right to build on Palestinian occupied land," he said.

Netanyahu came to power reluctant to carry out Israeli-PLO peace deals launched in 1993 by the Labour-led government he ousted. Peace talks have ground to a halt since March when Netanyahu started a Jewish settlement in East Jerusalem, which Israel occupied in 1967 and later annexed.
PLO officials said an Israeli plan to demolish 500 Palestinian homes in the West Bank amounted to a policy of ethnic cleansing likely to spark violence.
"These actions are leading to mounting Palestinian frustration which could spark popular violence directed not only against Israel but also against the Palestinian Authority," Abed Rabbo said.
"Palestinians only see land confiscations, building of settlements, house demolitions and a weak Authority. This will lead to a great explosion with dire consequences," Abed Rabbo said.
